full_judgment: 9. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the impugned judgment and order of the High Court Division, the condemned-prisoner, appellant preferred Criminal Appeal No.17 of 2015 before this Division Mr. Md. Jahangir Kabir, learned Advocate, appearing for the appellant, submits that the High Court Division misread, misconstrued and misunderstood the materials on record and consequently, failed to comprehend the facts of the case and misapplied the law. He further submits that the High Court Division failed to appreciate the facts and circumstances of this case in its true perspective. He further submits that the High Court Division erred in law in convicting the condemned-appellant without proper weighing and assessing the evidence on record and it is not safe to convict appellant on a charge of bomb attack upon dubious, tainted and interested evidence. He further submits that the High Court Division and the Tribunal below totally failed to evaluate the entire facts, circumstances and the evidence on record. It is further submitted that despite the prosecution Base is established, the court's primary duty is to find out as to whether the evidence led by the prosecution is true and substantially could prove the occurrence and the grounds formulated as to involvement of the condemned-appellant were illogical, unreasonable and perverse. He further submits that for the purpose of bringing safety in tithe dispensation of justice, it is necessary to consider the facts and circumstances of the case with judicial mind. He finally submits that after conviction and sentence awarded by the Tribunal, the presumption of innocence of the convict-appellant would continue until it is finally decided by the apex Court and it is the duty of the prosecution to show the Court that the judgment and order was passed according to law and on the basis of the admitted and proved evidence on record.
